result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to develop a dedicated handoff tracking tool for small software teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Discovery of handoff tracking workflows, pain points, and tool friction for small software teams in Latvia.
- Evaluation of integration needs with existing project management and collaboration platforms.
- Exclusion: Any payroll, billing, or financial advice functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Leads software delivery and sprint rituals, coordinating status handoffs across team members in Latvian software teams.

- How much time do team members spend each week compiling and transferring handoff updates between roles? (question-cc95238600966959a630f55d)
- What would motivate your team to adopt a specialized handoff tool rather than continuing with current task boards or wikis? (question-8f5de4bc66ec10e405ba0ef5)

## Software Developer

Executes daily development tasks and communicates progress, blockers, and handoff notes to teammates.

- What context or artifacts are most frequently missing when picking up work handed off by teammates? (question-803de0b40528fa1986cb869b)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small development teams in Latvia experience similar handoff coordination challenges as depicted in the synthetic operator interview.
- Handoff friction occurs regularly enough to warrant dedicated workflow intervention rather than minor procedural tweaks.

## Evidence gaps

- No empirical market research exists in the provided data quantifying the total addressable small software teams in Latvia.
- No pricing sensitivity or willingness-to-pay data is available for small Latvian engineering organizations.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
